title: The Only Woman Who Could Expose Kira Just Walked Up to Him . . . (Episode 6)
caption:
In Death Note episode 6, L finally shows his face to the task force, then Jack walks into police headquarters and meets Ray Penber's fiancée.
She has worked out how Kira kills, and she has no idea she is talking to him. Follow for episode 7!

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #fyp
comment: Would you have told Jack everything like Naomi did? Why?

segments.say: The one woman who can expose Jack walks right up to him, and he *smiles*.
To see how it got here, go back to the day the detectives meet *L* in person.
Five detectives walk into a hotel room to meet the greatest detective *alive*.
He is a thin, slouching man in a white shirt, and the detectives are *stunned*.
Then L suddenly shouts *bang*, and the whole room flinches.

segments.text: If I were Kira, you'd be dead.

segments.say: It is a test. He wants them to guard their names like their *lives*. Cold, but smart.
Next, he takes their phones. Nothing from this room leaves in anyone's *notes*.
Then L asks for a new name. From now on, they must call him *Ryuzaki*.
One detective has an idea. Hide the criminals' names from the news, and Kira runs out of *victims*.
L says no. Kira is childish and hates losing, and L knows because he is the *same*.
He reminds them of his broadcast, the one where Kira killed a *stand-in*.
Hide the bad guys, and Kira will kill the innocent instead. He would hold the whole world *hostage*.
L reads him like an open *book*.
Instead, L has a trick. He will tell the news that fifteen hundred investigators are coming, so Kira feels *cornered*.
Only seven people are really on the case. Kira cannot kill investigators who do not *exist*.
Then L lays out his theory. Twelve FBI agents entered Japan, and five days later Kira *knew*.
In those same days, Kira tested his power on prison inmates, to see how far he could control them *first*.
Then he got a file with every agent's name and face, and killed all *twelve*.
Meanwhile, Jack knows the hunters are circling. Nobody can ever learn he met Ray *Penber*. That is his weak spot.
Twenty-three people died of heart attacks in those days. Most were just *decoys*.
L is sure of one thing. Kira was one of the people the FBI was *investigating*.
He hands over the FBI's own files and splits the five detectives into two *teams*.
Then one detective asks the question on everyone's mind. Did showing his face mean L had *lost*?
L admits it. By showing his face, he lost the *battle*.

segments.text: But I'm not going to lose the war.

segments.say: He is risking his life to prove justice will win, and the detectives are *all in*.
But L still trusts nobody. Kira may be one of the people in this *room*.
That was his smartest move *yet*.
L waits for a single slip. Jack knows a single slip is all it would *take*.
Jack tells himself the bus was his only real risk, and nobody can connect it to *Kira*.
The police and L still do not know Kira can kill without a heart *attack*.
Then his mom needs someone to bring clean clothes to his dad at headquarters, so Jack *volunteers*.
Of course, he slips a page of the Death Note in his pocket, just in *case*. Careful, not careless.
Across town, Naomi connects the dots. Four people died in Shinjuku the day of the bus *hijacking*.
She works out that Kira can kill without a heart attack, so she heads for police *headquarters*.
Jack walks into police headquarters, and a woman at the front desk is begging for a *detective*.
She says she has information on Kira. Jack hears that, and Ryuk starts to *grin*.
So Jack steps in. He says his father runs the Kira case, and he can pass on her *message*.
Then he gets smooth. He offers his own phone, so she can talk to the chief *herself*.
She just walked into his *trap*.
Then they swap names. Jack gives his real name. She calls herself Shoko *Maki*.
Outside, Jack says Kira controls his victims. She agrees and goes *further*.
Kira can kill in other ways, she says, not only with heart *attacks*.
Jack freezes. How does this woman know so *much*?
She thinks someone she knew has met Kira, but the police will never take her *word*.
That someone was her fiancé, one of the twelve FBI agents who *died*.
Jack hears the name Ray Penber and hides his *shock*. He is good at this.
Ray got caught in a bus hijacking, and Naomi believes Kira *staged* it.
The man who hijacked the bus died in an accident, so Kira does not need a heart *attack*.
Then she drops the killer detail. Ray had to show his FBI badge to a *stranger*.
Whoever saw that badge is the man who killed all twelve *agents*.
Beside her stands the man she is looking for. Even Ryuk's eyes go *wide*.
She just solved the case by *herself*.
Jack plays along and agrees. The man on that bus had to be *Kira*.
Jack thinks it over. If she had reached the police first, he would be *done*.

segments.text: But it seems there's a God on my side after all.

segments.say: She gave him a fake name, and now Jack wants the *real* one. Follow for episode 7!
